change_summary: Added a runtime-only experiment runner for `macro_defensive_long`. The runner monkeypatches signal generation only during measurement and tests three variants: current accepted A+B baseline, macro-only, and A+B plus macro signals. No production trading code was promoted after measurement.
component: runtime-only `quant/experiments/legacy/exp_20260425_005_runner.py`, monkeypatching `signal_engine.generate_signals()` while keeping sizing, exits, accepted A+B residual rules, LLM gates, and portfolio constraints unchanged

delta_metrics.note: The experiment did test a new broad alpha class rather than another residual cohort. The macro sleeve is not vacuous: it generated 96 candidates and 12-13 executed macro trades in old_thin and improved A+B there. But the same static index-pressure activation loses money in both late_strong and mid_weak, so the edge is regime-conditional and too unstable to promote.

hypothesis: Instead of continuing to mine narrow residual A+B pockets, test a genuinely different alpha class: a defensive/macro continuation sleeve should add value when index pressure is negative and leadership rotates toward Commodities, Healthcare, or Energy. A valid sleeve should improve weak/macro windows without materially hurting the dominant trend window.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: slow-melt bull / accepted A+B stack dominant tape
market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where simple defensive rotation did not persist
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak macro tape where defensive/macro continuation showed partial usefulness

next_retry_requires: Do not promote or re-run the same static `index_pressure + defensive sector + above200 + positive RS` macro sleeve by default

If macro alpha returns, require a more distinctive macro-leadership state, such as commodity/defensive relative leadership plus weak A/B opportunity quality, not merely SPY/QQQ below their 200-day moving average
Consider gating macro exposure to periods where the normal A+B opportunity set is sparse or deteriorating, so macro does not compete with strong trend/breakout tapes
Do not treat this rejection as evidence that all macro strategies are invalid; it only rejects this first broad static defensive continuation form
notes: Single-causal-variable discipline held: only a new experiment-only signal sleeve was introduced for measurement. Production entry, exit, sizing rules, accepted residual cohort haircuts, LLM responsibilities, and C strategy remained unchanged.

parameters.index_pressure: SPY pct_from_200ma < 0 OR QQQ pct_from_200ma < 0 OR market_regime in {NEUTRAL, BEAR}
parameters.risk_model: standard ATR stop via ATR_STOP_MULT; no special production sizing rule

rejection_reason: Rejected on Gate 4 multi-window stability. A+B plus macro improves old_thin EV from 0.0322 to 0.0631, but regresses late_strong from 0.9534 to 0.8967 and mid_weak from 0.2860 to 0.2011; macro-only also has negative total return in late_strong and mid_weak. Simple defensive sector plus index-pressure continuation is not a stable standalone alpha.
